Earlier work, terminal preparation, unsuccessful acquisition and verification are separate charged costs. Finite limits are not unrestricted-SAT efficiency or exhaustion claims.

All eighteen new unique controls and four repeats are already covered by the preceding policies. The three gained SAT roots were previously exposed; families recur and there is no external generalization result.

One-round widening gains three roots but loses four feedback verdicts. Two-round widening retains all feedback verdicts, costing 2.78% more than feedback and 54.91% more than fresh. Prefix reuse is 0.055% slower on average than restart, with mixed signs.

Prefix reuse avoids 3960 projected rows and 34024 reserved table probes but adds exactly that many verified rows/probes. Cold replay still independently validates the complete source-bound prefix plus suffix.

Exact operator census matches measured counters; it implements no trusted cache. The 15.90% distinct-source weighted probe opportunity is not a claim of nonconstant transfer across SAT categories or runtime savings.

The three remaining frontiers are active Boolean factors after projection, not unchanged CNF clauses. Wider diagnostic certificates are checked leaf results and excluded from measured root coverage and costs.
